content.text: [CDPH Official Letter from Inspector Linda Wu Fri Jan 10 2026 09:00 PST] SUPPLEMENTAL INSPECTION NOTICE — SVMC Ref# 050123-SVMC-SUP-01. A supplemental inspection conducted December 27, 2025 – January 9, 2026 identified additional Telemetry unit violations. See attached: cdph_supplemental_inspection_jan2026.txt and SVMC_telemetry_violations_dec2025_jan2026.csv. Total new violations: 12 Telemetry night shifts (4 pre-2026-01-01, 7 post-2026-01-01 under SB 596 daily-violation rule, plus 1 spanning the boundary). Post-2026-01-01 violations are each counted as separate violations per SB 596. Your penalty assessment must be updated to reflect these additional findings.

CDPH Supplemental inspection notice received and documented. Key changes to track:
1. 12 additional Telemetry violations (4 pre-SB596 + 7 post-SB596 daily violations + 1 boundary date counted as pre-SB596 = 5 pre + 7 post total).
2. Post-2026-01-01 Telemetry violations: each calendar day = separate violation under SB 596.
3. Penalty assessment must be updated (Q9 will recalculate total with Telemetry added).
I will update the violation ledger and penalty totals to reflect this supplemental finding.
